messages:
alex: quick ping 3: noticed runtime guide has a broken fragment when linking from the onboarding checklist: https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/runtime#kv-cachedeep. Page loads but doesn't scroll.

priya: thanks. prod or staging? could be a heading tweak.

alex: prod. grep shows the string in `workshops/cache-101.md` and `onboarding/checklist.md`.

morgan: I updated runtime headings yesterday to normalize casing and dashes. happy to take ownership and patch callers.

alex: plan: morgan will add `owners: "@docs/runtime"` to runtime frontmatter and open a tiny PR updating the two callers. I'll run a local link-check preview before merge.

infra-bot: link-checker (weekly) found fragment `/serving/runtime.html#kv-cachedeep` -> created issue #5050.

priya: don't do repo-wide sed without a preview. use a branch and list files in the PR body. also add a changelog line: "docs: fix runtime fragment links".

morgan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420 3 updated two files + frontmatter owners set. Preview link verifies fragment jump.

docs-bot: CI preview: fragment checks passed for updated pages. No remaining failures for /serving/runtime.

alex: thx all 2 resolving. If the weekly checker re-triggers we'll reopen.
